scripts.hash-password: node -e "const crypto=require('crypto'); const password=process.argv[1]; if (!password) throw new Error('Usage: npm run hash-password -- your-password'); const salt=crypto.randomBytes(16); crypto.scrypt(password,salt,64,(e,key)=>{if(e)throw e; console.log(salt.toString('base64url')+':'+key.toString('base64url'))})"
